capabilities: Pin folders and tags as customizable tabs
Assign icons, colors and appearance rules
Browse bookmarks, recents and properties in a side view
disambiguation: Not a vault-linking or web portal tool; it is a tab-based file browser enhancement.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; warns to back up data.json before updates; mobile works best with Baseline theme.
intentEvidence: Portals enhances your Obsidian file navigation by letting you pin any folder or tag as a customisable tab
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no way to pin folders or tags as quick-access tabs with custom icons, colors and grouping.
summary: File browser that pins folders and tags as customizable tabs with icons, colors, stacks and a side view for bookmarks, recents and properties.
